description.blurb: Artemis I is an uncrewed flight test that is the first mission to use NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) and the Orion spacecraft. It will be followed by a crewed flight on Artemis II.
description.more: The first in a series of increasingly complex missions, Artemis I is an uncrewed flight test that will provide a foundation for human deep space exploration, and demonstrate our commitment and capability to extend human existence to the Moon and beyond. The spacecraft launched on the most powerful rocket in the world and flew farther than any spacecraft built for humans has ever flown, traveling thousands of miles past the moon, then entering a distant retrograde orbit of the moon before returning to Earth.
